You will manage a growing team, focusing on delivering high-quality services, driving continuous improvement, and handling operational responsibilities for more complex tax jurisdictions. Key Responsibilities include: Leadership and Team Management: Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of indirect tax professionals to deliver exceptional results and foster a collaborative team culture. Coach and guide team members, helping them develop technical skills and ensuring high-quality outputs. Manage team performance by setting clear objectives, monitoring progress, and addressing challenges proactively. Act as the primary point of escalation for complex issues and ensure timely resolution. Drive team engagement and align efforts toward achieving strategic goals. Strategic Oversight and Core Model Implementation: Implement and ensure alignment with the SBS core model for indirect tax processes across all countries. Propose and lead projects aimed at standardizing, transforming, and automating tax processes, including the adoption of Robotic Process Automation (RPA). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Ensure alignment with the organization’s strategic vision and act as a key driver in implementing process improvements. Compliance and Operational Excellence: Oversee compliance responsibilities for more complex countries or entities, ensuring all indirect tax filings and reconciliations meet local regulatory requirements. Perform hands-on tasks, including preparing, reconciling, and submitting indirect tax returns and journals for high-risk or complex jurisdictions. Conduct real-time reviews of indirect tax treatments and transactions to ensure proper tax accounting and compliance. Maintain and enhance tax internal controls and governance, ensuring all process guides and documentation are up to date. Partner with the business to provide indirect tax advice and address queries related to more intricate tax matters. Operations for Complex Countries or Entities: Take direct responsibility for operational tasks related to complex countries/entities, including preparing MyTax Package Reports, managing tax risk provisions, and resolving SOLAR controls. Handle indirect tax audits and serve as the key liaison with tax authorities for the most challenging jurisdictions. Prepare and reconcile monthly balance sheet accounts for tax-related general ledger (GL) accounts for these entities. Lead pre-close and quarterly tax risk discussions for high-risk jurisdictions. Indirect Tax Returns: Conduct real-time reviews of indirect tax treatments for unusual transactions to ensure proper tax accounting. Review indirect tax postings in SAP, using RPA or manual processes, and correct errors as needed. Prepare, reconcile, and submit indirect tax returns, ensuring compliance with local regulations. Process indirect tax journals and reconcile indirect tax ledgers to maintain accurate records. Analyze trends in indirect tax returns and provide detailed insights. Reporting and Risk Management: Coordinate pre-close discussions to agree on group and local tax treatments in advance. Extract and consolidate tax data from SAP and other sources for reporting purposes. Prepare and control MyTax files, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tax provisions. Finalize and publish MyTax risk packages, resolving any blocking controls. Assist with tax audits by providing required documentation, reconciliations, and calculations. Tax Audit Management: Provide copies of relevant tax returns, reconciliations, detailed tax calculations, and supporting documentation required by local tax authorities. Monthly Balance Sheet Reconciliation: Prepare and maintain monthly reconciliations for tax-related general ledger (GL) accounts. Ensure accuracy and resolve discrepancies promptly, adhering to internal controls. Continuous Improvement and Project Management: Identify and implement opportunities for process enhancements and operational efficiency, leveraging automation tools and technologies. Lead and manage projects assigned to the indirect tax team, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives. Regularly monitor updates to tax legislation and assess their impact on compliance and operational processes, ensuring the team remains proactive in addressing changes. Drive customer satisfaction initiatives by building strong relationships with stakeholders and addressing feedback effectively. About You Essential Skills and Experience Leadership: Proven ability to manage, coach, and inspire a team to achieve results in a collaborative and high-performance environment. Tax Expertise: At least 8 years of experience in taxation, with significant exposure to indirect tax compliance, advisory, and operations in complex jurisdictions. Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical skills to detect errors, identify risks, and provide actionable recommendations for improvement. Operational Excellence: Hands-on experience in managing indirect tax operations, particularly for high-risk or complex entities. Process Improvement: Demonstrated ability to identify and implement process enhancements and automation tools. Critical Thinking: A detail-oriented, critical thinker who proactively addresses challenges and drives improvements. Stakeholder Engagement: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders effectively. Project Management: Experience in leading and delivering projects, particularly those related to process transformation and compliance improvements. Proficiency in MS Excel, including advanced features for data analysis and reconciliation. Experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems is required for managing tax data, reconciliations, and journal entries. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Desirable Skills and Experience Background in a Finance Shared Services environment, either captive (in-house) or BPO. Familiarity with automation technologies, including RPA and SAP or similar ERP systems. Experience in managing indirect tax operations across multiple jurisdictions. Chez Sanofi, tu auras la liberté d’apprendre, de poser des questions et de donner vie à tes idées, le tout soutenu par des mentors inspirants et des équipes collaboratives. À propos de Sanofi : Sanofi est une entreprise biopharmaceutique qui innove en R&D et exploite l'IA à grande échelle pour améliorer la vie des gens et créer de la croissance à long terme. Notre compréhension approfondie du système immunitaire – et notre pipeline innovant – nous permet d’inventer des médicaments et des vaccins qui traitent et protègent des millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Ensemble, nous poursuivons les miracles de la science pour améliorer la vie des gens. Principales responsabilités : Participer à la transformation de la valeur externe en valeur interne en développant des méthodes pour convertir les livrables des projets externes en bénéfices opérationnels concrets pour les équipes Contribuer à identifier les opportunités d'usage et mobiliser les relais métiers pour faciliter l'intégration des apports des consortia. Soutenir la valorisation du portefeuille collaboratif et mettre en valeur les résultats des consortia et améliorer leur diffusion auprès des équipes internes Accompagner le développement d'une méthode de quantification en élaborant une approche structurée pour mesurer objectivement les bénéfices générés par les consortia sur les opérations cliniques Être impliqué dans le pilotage des indicateurs de performance pour définir, structurer et suivre les KPIs nécessaires à l'évaluation de l'impact des partenariats. Appuyer la production de supports d'analyse stratégique en créer des livrables pour le senior management (revues trimestrielles, tableaux de bord, aide à la décision) Participer activement à la coordination et à l'animation du réseau interne tel que l’organisation des réunions, la diffusion d’informations et la structuration des partenariats À propos de vous Compétences techniques et relationnelles : aisance relationnelle, curiosité, capacité de communication. Connaissances en gestion de projets analyse quantitative et qualitative Éducation : bac+5/6 en biologie, école de commerce, ingénierie ou innovation Langues : anglais courant Pourquoi nous choisir ? Lance ta carrière dans une entreprise qui investit en toi, et te donne les moyens de réinventer ce qui est possible. Construis ton avenir avec les outils les plus récents, l’innovation digitale et un apprentissage continu pour toujours garder une longueur d’avance. Évolue dans une entreprise engagée où ta voix compte et où ton travail améliore la vie de millions de personnes. Épanouis-toi dans des environnements inclusifs et flexibles qui soutiennent ton bien-être personnel et professionnel. Profitez d’une rémunération attractive et l’accès à un grand nombre d’avantages (Intéressement et participation, Plan Actionnariat Salarié, Activités sociales CSE) Bénéficiez de 31 jours de congés par an et jusqu’à 5 jours d'absence "préparation examen" rémunérés, en fonction de votre contrat d’alternance (apprentissage, professionnalisation). Notre processus de recrutement a été pensé pour être rapide et efficace. Si votre candidature est retenue, vous recevrez un appel de notre recruteur.se pour un premier échange téléphonique puis pour rencontrer rapidement le ou la manager. Toujours Progresser. Découvrir l’Extraordinaire. Rejoignez Sanofi et entrez dans une nouvelle ère de la science – où votre parcours peut être aussi transformateur que le travail que nous accomplissons. Nous investissons en vous pour que vous alliez plus loin, accélériez votre réflexion et accomplissiez ce qui n’a jamais été fait auparavant. Vous contribuerez à repousser les limites, à bousculer les conventions et à concevoir des solutions plus intelligentes pour les communautés que nous servons. Prêt·e à poursuivre les miracles de la science et à améliorer la vie des gens ? Poursuivons le progrès et découvrons l’extraordinaire – ensemble. Chez Sanofi, nous croyons dans l’égalité des chances, sans distinction de race, de couleur, d’ascendance, de religion, de sexe, d’origine, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de citoyenneté, d’état civil, de handicap, d’identité de genre ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people. Negotiation skills Search and sourcing skills Deep understanding of recruitment best practices, processes, and technologies, including experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and HR information systems. | Sanofi | Product Owner - PSPV | Morristown | Posted 10 Days Ago | onsite | internship | junior |  | Pharmaceutical | Job title: Product Owner - PSPV Location: Morristown, NJ About the job As Product Owner - PSPV within our Digital team , you will be committed to providing the next-generation healthcare that patients and customers need. At Sanofi, we're transforming how we bring medicines to patients faster while improving operational efficiency and ensuring regulatory compliance. The Digital Launch & Market Product team (LMP) is one of the key vertical towers within Digital R&D, including product line teams serving global Regulatory Affairs (GRA), Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV), R&D CMO/Medical, and other domains. We focus on delivery of innovative digital products to support and accelerate product launches, reducing cycle times to bring medicines to patients faster. This position operates within the Digital Launch & Market Product (LMP) - Patient Safety and Pharmacovigilance (PSPV) Product Line, whose mission is to help improve Patient Safety with AI and automation-enabled digital solutions. As Digital Product Owner, you will be accountable to define strategy and roadmap, drive delivery and management, and measure value and impact of the digital product. Join the digital engine driving Sanofi’s transformation - where AI, automation, and bold experimentation power faster science and smarter decisions. Here, you’ll help build the first biopharma company powered by AI at scale. About Sanofi We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main Responsibilities Product Vision: Set and communicate - the vision for the product, working closely with Digital and Business Leadership and key stakeholders. The iCare Test Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying test plans within iCare Eco System while aiming to automate, simplify, and accelerate testing while adhering to quality standards. Ensure all solutions comply with PHI (Protected Health Information) and PII (Personally Identifiable Information) regulations. Demonstrated initiative and analytical thinking style, able to comprehend complex problems and good problem solving skills Proven track record of being a strong team player.
